lines: One day after school, as spring was approaching in full force.
I had spread my books out in the cafeteria, where we had agreed to meet, and was groaning by myself.
Me
Hmm... I give up, I can't understand this at all, from top to bottom...
Gosha Academy was a training institution for young TaimaninーBut just like an ordinary school, there were subject exams as well.
If your scores were good, everything was A-OK. But if they were bad, you'd be repeating the gradeー
From the standpoint of a good-for-nothing student like me, it was truly a cruel ordeal in hell.
And in order to overcome this somehow, it was decided that we'd hold an emergency study session with Shikanosuke and Hebiko.
Me
(This... isn't something I can handle on my own. Either of you will do, so please, get back here quick...)
What I was doing right now was a workbook for English, which was not my cup of tea, and I had been skipping classes like crazy.
I was sure that if I begged to be taught by Hebiko and Shikanosuke, who were always serious about attending classes, they'd answer as many of my questions as they could, butー
Unfortunately, Hebiko was at a class committee meeting and Shikanosuke had been told to take care of something by our homeroom teacher, Sakura-senseiー
And that's why I was all alone, with my notebook open futilely, waiting for them to return.
Me
(I mean, I was already in a pinch just with the exams, but Shizuru-sensei even gave me a mountain of homework to do...)
Me
("If you don't do all of it you'll fail♪"...she said...)
Me
(That teacher definitely enjoys bullying meー)
Hey you, you don't even understand a question like that? The answer for that one is A. And then it's B and Dー
Me
Eh? Ah, yes. I see, I see...
Suddenly, a voice offering advice dropped in from behind me. It was precise and easy to understand. I was proceeding through the questions smoothly.
Me
(...Hm? Wait, who is that?)
For a second, I had thought it might have been Hebiko, who always helped me, but the voice was clearly different. So that meantー?
Me
Um...? And who might you be?
An unfamiliar female student was standing there.
She was ridiculously cuteーbut she was looking down on me with an oddly displeased look on her face.
Woman
Does it matter who I am? More importantly... Hmmm.
Me
Wh-What is it...?
Woman
Nothing～ I was just surprised. You're the captain of the Independent Commando Unit, aren't you?
Woman
So, I was just thinking about how even someone this stupid can become a captain♪
Me
Huuuh!!?
This woman suddenly showed up and started shooting her mouth offー!?
Woman
I mean, if you can't even answer those questions, you're at the most basic of the basics, totally failing level.
Woman
Someone having this much trouble is a captain? *Sigh*...
The woman shrugged her shoulders as if to say, "Good grief, I'm flabbergasted." It was as irritating as could be.
Me
N-No, no, no!!! I'm not stupid at all!! I mean, you're the stupid one!!
Woman
Huh!? I'm the stupid one!?
Me
Yes!! Judging how smart people are from just one subject is, without question, what stupid people do!!
Me
Sure, I'm not good at English, but I'm absolutely confident that I'm better than you in everything else～
Woman
What the hell!? There's no way I would lose against someone like you!!
Me
Wanna throw down then? With a different subject.
Woman
F-Fine with me. Any subject is fine.
Me
(Nice!! Got her!!! Just as plannedー!!)
Deep down, I struck a triumphant pose.
She seemed to be prideful, so I had figured that if I provoked her I would be able to face her in a more favorable contest.
Me
Okay, it's a history question battle. First question.
Woman
R-Right off the bat!? History!?
Me
Drum roll, please. The founder of the Tokugawa Shogunate was Tokugawa Ieyasu, but who was the tenth shogun?
Woman
Eeeh!? Sh-Shogun!? I-Ie-Ie... Ienori?
Me
Bzzzzt. It was Ieharu.
Woman
C'mon!! There's too many Ie-somethings!!
Me
On to the second question. Drum roll... Who was the 20th president of the UFS?
Woman
Eh? Um... C-Clynton...?
Me
Bzz bzzzzt. It was Garfeeld.
Woman
Who is that!?
Me
Hahahaha!! Both of these questions were the most basic of the basics that can be found in any elementary textbook!!
Me
Seeing as you couldn't even answer these kinds of questionsーLooks like it's clear now which of us is the stupid one!!!
It had been a walk in the park. When it came to not-particularly-necessary knowledge like this, there wasn't anyone who could outdo me.
Woman
Hnngh...! This just shows that you're a history nerd!! Th-There's nothing great about that!!
Me
What!? You still won't admit defeat!?
Woman
Of course I won't!!! I won't be defeated by a man!
Me
Hehe, then I've got no choice. I'll move on to questions three and four, until you cry and apologizeー
Hebiko
Hey, hey. What are you doing, Fuma-chan, shouting like that?
Shikanosuke
She's right, Fuma. You need to keep quiet in public places!
Me
Eh?
When I turned around, the usual two were standing there with exasperated looks on their faces.
And when I looked around the room, I could see the other students looking over here as well, seemingly wondering, "What the heck are they doing?"
Me
Ah, no... you've got it all wrong. While I was waiting for you guys, I was getting pestered by some strange womanー
I pointed at the female student I was arguing with.
Hebiko
A strange woman...? She's an upperclassman, Fuma-chan.
Hebiko
Hello, Kirara-senpai.
Woman
Ah, Hebiko-chan. Good afternoon. It's been a while.
Me
What!? Senpai!!?
Noticing the woman, Hebiko greeted her. It seemed like she and Hebiko were acquaintances.
Hebiko
Yes, this is Onisaki Kirara-senpai. She's always helping Hebiko during the class committee meetings.
Hebiko introduced the womanーOnisaki Kirara.
Shikanosuke
Geez, Fuma, you're weirdly unobservant. You can tell from the color of her necktie that she's a senpai, you know?
Me
That's, well... true.
Even Shikanosuke spoke to me with a fed-up tone in his voice.
It had all been so sudden, so I had missed it, but... at Gosha Academy, each grade's uniform had a different color necktie.
And the color of the necktie worn by Onisaki Kirara, who was standing before me with a sullen look on her face, was red. That meantー
Me
Y-You're... our senpai?
Onisaki Kirara
Hmph. No need to get all respectful at this point. You showed your true colors very clearly just now.
Me
Huuh!!?
She was impossible to deal with. This senpaiーcould it be that she was rather nasty!?
Me
N-No, you're wrong!! You're the one who started it, so I just answered tit for tatー
Igawa Asagi
Oh? Looks like everyone is here already. Hello, everyone. ーKirara as well, did you already introduce yourself?
Just as I had been trying to retort, Asagi-sensei showed up.
Me
Asagi-sensei!? H-Hello... And what do you mean by "Kirara as well"...?
Returning the greeting, I looked at Onisaki Kirara.
The way she had put it, did it mean that this senpai was here at Asagi-sensei's suggestion?
Kirara
...Yes, Asagi-sensei. I talked with Fuma-kun a bit.
Kirara replied with a sullen look on her face.
She had said it with some meaning implied, but Asagi-sensei smiled while paying no mind.
Asagi
Hehe, that's good to hear. Well then, sorry to cut to the chase, but I have something to ask of you, of the Independent Commando Unit.
Me
!? Is it a new mission!?
I exchanged glances with Hebiko and Shikanosuke. After the challenging undercover mission in Yomihara, where so many things had happened, it was our first real mission in quite a while.
Asagi
Yes... I want you to look into the strange events that have been occurring in Tokyo Kingdom recently. And Kirara here will be your help♪
Kirara
Asagi-sensei smiled and pointed at the still pouting woman.
Me
Sorry? This person is... our help?
That nightー
We, the commando unit, now including Kirara-senpai, immediately went to Tokyo Kingdom where the strange events were said to be occurring.
According to what Asagi-sensei had saidー
Our target this time was the witch Euryale.
Recently, this witch, who was referred to as "legendary," had appeared in Tokyo Kingdom.
And the balance of power between the forces of darkness, which had been in equilibrium, had been upset.
That was because Euryale was a legendary witch who had wandered the Devildom since ancient times, on top of being a godlike demon with enormous powers.
She had lost both arms due to a curse from the old gods, but instead was able to freely control two giant swords with a magic spell called "Invisible Hand."
Appearing in the human world on a whim, she brought about misfortune and chaos.
She was known as an uncontrollable trickster.
Me
Until now, rumor had it that she was hiding quietly in Amidahara.
Me
I don't know what she's after, but... apparently she recently showed up in Tokyo Kingdom.
Shikanosuke
Hmmm, I see. So this E-E... Eruryaryale.
Me
Euryale.
Shikanosuke
So this Euryale... You seem to know a lot about her, Fuma.
Me
Well, yeah. That's because I'm a fan of hers.
I nodded to Shikanosuke. There were many treatises and biographies written about the legendary witch Euryale.
And she herself had also authored several magic books and tales.
They were all about interesting magic spells and events, and I loved reading them.
Kirara
Huhh? What's the fun in reading those musty, old books?
Kirara
Don't get me started on fanaticsーDon't you have anything else to do?
Me
What!!?
This nasty senpai was at it againー!
Hebiko
Come on, Fuma-chan, calm down, calm down.
Laughing loudly, Hebiko tried to settle me down.
Hebiko
And you too, Kirara-senpai. Fuma-chan's love of books is often quite useful, you know?
Kirara
Eh...? I-Is that so, Hebiko-chan...?
Hebiko
Yes. Fuma-chan's knowledge from books has helped Heberybody many times beforeー
Hebiko
Hebiko feels sorry for him, so please don't say anything too harsh♪
Kirara
Hmm... You're right, I'm sorry, Hebiko-chan. I'll give it some thought.
Admonished by Hebiko, Kirara-senpai apologized to her sincerely.
Me
(Wait, wait!! Why is she apologizing to Hebiko!?)
And anyway... it also felt as if I was the only one she was being so harsh to.
Toward Hebiko and Shikanosuke, she was acting like a normal, kind senpai... But why?
Me
W-Well, back to the subjectーlet's continue the mission review.
In any case, there was no use thinking about it now.
I pulled myself together and resumed talking about the mission.
There were signs of disturbances in Tokyo Kingdom due to the appearance of the "Legendary Witch"ー
Contact had suddenly been lost with the Taimanin unit that had been dispatched to investigate the situation.
The main objective of this mission was to search for the missing unit, and rescue them if circumstances permitted it.
However, the opponent was the mysterious witch Euryale.
We had been ordered to avoid combat as much as possible, and to retreat as soon as we sensed danger so that we would not suffer casualties as well.
Me
And this is... This is where the missing unit made its last regularly scheduled report.
Hebiko & Kirara
Hebiko and Kirara-senpai looked around, their faces tense with anxiety.
...The atmosphere was eerie.
We were in a desolate, abandoned neighborhood a few blocks from the downtown area.
It was the kind of place that outlaws would love to pick for their hideout... but there was no sign of anyone around at all.
Shikanosuke
H-Hey... will we be alright, Fuma? There's something strange about this place...
Me
Something strange...?
Shikanosuke
Y-Yeah... My skin is kind of tingling... and I'm starting to feel sick...
Me
Was something invisible affecting Shikanosuke's body, which was sensitive to radio waves...?
Me
...Anyway, let's have a look around. Hebiko, picking up anything?
Hebiko
Wait a moment. Um...? Yes, just a single person over there. Looks like there is someone...
Hebiko, who had transformed into an octopus, pointed towards the darkness deep within the abandoned neighborhood.
The powerful olfactory sense of the suckers on her octopus tentacles had caught the scent of a person.
Me
Alright. Let's check there first. Everyone, don't let your guard downー
We lowered our voices and nodded to each other, and then proceeded deeper into the abandoned neighborhood.
We followed the scent deep into the abandoned neighborhoodーand then broke into a warehouse in a corner of the district.
Shikanosuke
(H-Hey... Fuma, is this place...?)
Me
(Yeah... I can "smell" it...)
I whispered with Shikanosuke, who was walking next to me, holding his breath.
It was not the smell from the person that Hebiko's suckers had sensed.
The inside of the warehouse was distinctly unnatural.
Me
(It's properly cleaned and maintained...)
From the outside, it looked like a decrepit ruin, but the inside was completely different.
This meant that this warehouse was still being used by someoneー
Hebiko
Kirara
(S-Someone's thereー!?)
We stayed in the shadows as we moved forward, and across from us, a solitary woman was standing.
Without even the slightest movement, she was standing still just like a ghost.
Hebiko
(F-Fuma-chan!? Those clothes... that's a Taimanin suit, isn't it? Then that means she'sー)
Me
(...No, I don't think she is. I've got all the information regarding the missing unit in my head.)
She was wearing a Taimanin suit, but she was not a member of the missing unit.
Then just who was this womanー?
Shikanosuke
(H-Heyyyyyyyy!? That's kind of super scaryyy!!)
Me
(C-Calm down, Shikanosuke! ...Anyway, let's get a closer look. Kirara-senpai, are you okay with that?)
Kirara
(Wh-Why are you the one deciding...! I mean, I'm okay with it though...)
We nodded to each other and cautiously approached the woman wearing the Taimanin suit.
Howeverー
『...Thou art the voidー...』
Me
Suddenly, the woman opened her mouth.
She was whispering softly... but in my ears, the strange chanting echoed deafeninglyー
Me
(This is bad!! Did that woman notice usー!?)
Our presence should have been completely hidden, so howー?
But the woman's whispering continued as if she was mocking our confusion, and eventuallyー
『...One thousand lights, engulfing ten thousand lives, the darkness shinesー...』
*Bzzzzzzz...!*
Kirara
Wh-What is that!? A magic circleー!!?
At the same time the woman's short, chant-like whispering endedー
A giant magic circle appeared under our feet and began to emit an intense light.
Shikanosuke
Aieeeeeee!! This looks super bad!!
Hebiko
Fuma-chan!? We need to get out of hereー!!
Me
Yeah!! Everyone, get out of here as fast as youー
I wasn't even able to finish shouting my order.
We were enveloped by the light emitted by the magic circle and instantly swallowed up.
*Thudー!!*
I was dropped out of thin air.
Me
!? Owowow...
I rose to my feet, rubbing my banged-up butt.
Looking around, I could vaguely see what seemed to be the remains of a railroad track within the heavy darkness.
This place looked like an abandoned subway tunnel.
Me
(Guess we were scattered around...)
It must have been some kind of teleportation spell.
There was no one here but me.
Me
(...In that case, I have to look for them first.)
Hebiko and Shikanosuke, and also... Kirara-senpai.
Setting up such a powerful teleportation spell...
That must have meant that the strange woman in the Taimanin suit had been the witch we were after.
I wanted to look for everyone right away and do a more detailed investigation.
Me
...Well, but...
Me
(If possible, I want to find Hebiko or Shikanosuke first...)
If I ended up finding Kirara-senpai first, then it would be just the two of us.
And I'd have to hear it from her again...
At that moment...
*Thudー!!*
Kirara
Kyaah!? Ow, owow... What the hell... Where am I...?
Me
Ah!?
Of all the people who could have fallen out of thin airー
It was my natural enemy, Onisaki Kirara-senpai.
And then, things got even worse.
Will-o'-wisp
GRR-ROOOGH...
From behind her, countless demonic creatures appeared one after anotherー
